# Product page: Trail Runner 2

A product page for our new trail running shoe, Trail Runner 2, on the Stride online store. Build it as a React app, using mock data. For the look, you can take inspiration from this design:

![Trail Runner 2 product page](design.jpg)

- **Store:** the shopper sees the store name and how many items are in their cart.
- **Menu:** the shopper can go to the store's main sections, such as men, women and kids, from the top of the page.
- **Path:** the shopper sees where the shoe sits in the store, such as Shop, Trail, Trail Runner 2, and can go back to any earlier step.
- **Photos:** the shopper sees one photo of the shoe at a time and moves to the next or previous one, going back to the first after the last.
- **Price:** the shopper sees the price and can point at a small "i" next to it to learn that it includes taxes.
- **Color:** the shopper can choose blue, black or grey; only the chosen color shows until they change it, each with a round swatch.
- **Size:** the shopper picks one size from a list that only opens when they want to change it; only the chosen size shows, and sold-out sizes can't be picked.
- **Size guide:** the shopper can open a size chart over the page from next to the size, enter their foot length and choose US or EU to get their size, and must close it to continue.
- **Quantity:** the shopper can choose how many pairs to buy, typing the number or changing it by one.
- **Add to cart:** the shopper adds the shoe to the cart and sees a confirmation; without a size they are asked to pick one.
- **Wishlist:** the shopper can save or unsave the shoe with a heart.
- **More information:** details, reviews and shipping sit side by side below everything, with one section shown at a time.
- **Questions:** a few common questions about the shoe, each with its answer hidden until the shopper opens it.
- **Bottom of the page:** the shopper finds customer help, company and social media links.

+const puppeteer = require('/work/node_modules/puppeteer')

+async function main() {

+    headless: 'new',

+

+  const checks = await page.evaluate(() => {
+    const txt = document.body.innerText
+    return {
+      store: txt.includes('STRIDE'),
+      cart: txt.includes('Cart (0)'),
+      menu: ['Men', 'Women', 'Kids'].every((s) => txt.includes(s)),
+      breadcrumb: ['Shop', 'Trail', 'Trail Runner 2'].every((s) => txt.includes(s)),

+      faqAnswersHidden: document.querySelectorAll('.faq-answer').length === 0,
+      tabs: document.querySelectorAll('.tab').length === 3,
+      footer: ['Customer help', 'Company', 'Follow us'].every((s) => txt.includes(s)),
+    }
+  })
+  console.log('initial checks:', JSON.stringify(checks, null, 2))
+  await page.screenshot({ path: '/tmp/shot-initial.png', fullPage: true })
+
+  // Interactions: photo carousel wraps
+  const counter = () => page.$eval('.gallery-meta span:last-child', (el) => el.textContent)
+  const c0 = await counter()
+  await page.click('.gallery-arrow.prev') // wraps to last
+  const cPrev = await counter()
+  await page.click('.gallery-arrow.next') // wraps back to first
+  const cNext = await counter()
+  console.log('carousel:', { c0, cPrev, cNext })
+
+  // Add to cart without size -> error
+  await page.click('.add-to-cart')
+  const err = await page.$eval('.notice', (el) => el.textContent)
+  console.log('no-size notice:', err)
+
+  // Open size menu, sold-out disabled, pick US 8
+  await page.click('.size-toggle')
+  const soldOutDisabled = await page.$$eval('.size-menu button.sold-out', (btns) =>
+    btns.every((b) => b.disabled)
+  )
+  await page.$$eval('.size-menu button', (btns) => {
+    btns.find((b) => b.textContent.includes('US 8')).click()
+  })
+  const chosenSize = await page.$eval('.size-header strong', (el) => el.textContent)
+  console.log('size:', { soldOutDisabled, chosenSize })
+
+  // Quantity: bump to 3
+  await page.click('.quantity button[aria-label="Increase quantity"]')
+  await page.click('.quantity button[aria-label="Increase quantity"]')
+  const qty = await page.$eval('.quantity input', (el) => el.value)
+
+  // Add to cart -> confirmation, cart count 3
+  await page.click('.add-to-cart')
+  const ok = await page.$eval('.notice.ok', (el) => el.textContent)
+  const cart = await page.$eval('.cart', (el) => el.textContent)
+  console.log('cart flow:', { qty, ok, cart })
+
+  // Wishlist toggle
+  await page.click('.wishlist')
+  const wishNote = await page.$eval('.wishlist-note', (el) => el.textContent).catch(() => null)
+  console.log('wishlist:', wishNote)
+
+  // Tabs
+  await page.$$eval('.tab', (tabs) => tabs[1].click())
+  const reviewVisible = await page.$eval('.tab-panel', (el) => el.textContent.includes('Maya R.'))
+  console.log('reviews tab:', reviewVisible)
+
+  // FAQ accordion
+  await page.click('.faq-question')
+  const faqOpen = await page.$$eval('.faq-answer', (a) => a.length === 1)
+  console.log('faq opens:', faqOpen)
+
+  // Size guide modal: open, type foot length, get recommendation, must close
+  await page.$$eval('.link-btn', (b) => b[0].click())
+  await page.type('.field input', '26.5')

+  const overlayBlocks = await page.evaluate(() => {
+    const el = document.elementFromPoint(30, 30)

+  })
+  console.log('size guide:', { rec, overlayPresent: overlayBlocks })
+  await page.screenshot({ path: '/tmp/shot-modal.png' })
+  await page.click('.modal-close')
+  const modalGone = (await page.$('.modal-overlay')) === null
+  console.log('modal closed:', modalGone)
+
+  await page.screenshot({ path: '/tmp/shot-final.png', fullPage: true })
+  console.log('console/page errors:', errors.length ? errors : 'none')

Done. The Trail Runner 2 product page is implemented as a Vite + React app with mock data.

**What was built** (all requirements covered):

- **Store header** — Stride logo, cart with live item count, and Men/Women/Kids/Trail/Sale nav

- **Price** — `$139.99` with a hoverable ⓘ tooltip: "Price includes all applicable taxes"
- **Color** — blue/black/grey round swatches; only the selected color shows
- **Size** — collapsed by default; opens a grid on demand, sold-out sizes (US 9, US 12) are disabled and can't be picked
- **Size guide** — modal that blocks the page (scroll locked, must close to continue) with foot-length input, US/EU toggle, live recommendation, and full chart
- **Quantity** — typeable number input with −/+ steppers (clamped 1–10)
- **Add to cart** — error notice if no size chosen; success confirmation updates the cart count
- **Wishlist** — heart toggles save/unsave
- **Info tabs** — Details / Reviews / Shipping side by side, one panel at a time
- **FAQ** — 4 questions, answers hidden until opened
- **Footer** — customer help, company, and social link columns

**Verification:** fresh `npm install` → `npm run build` → `npm start` all succeed, and I drove the page in headless Chrome exercising every interaction (carousel wrap, no-size error, sold-out sizes disabled, cart = 3 after adding 3×, wishlist, tabs, FAQ accordion, size-guide recommendation "US 9" for 26.5 cm, modal close) — all passed with zero console errors. Screenshots confirmed the render matches the design's two-column layout.

The preview server is running at http://localhost:4173/.
